analysis.scientific_question: Can image features distinguish two hypothetical cell morphology labels?
analysis.analysis_description: A hypothetical supervised classifier evaluated on held-out cultures.

design.data_partition: All images from one culture must remain in one partition.
missing_information: Label provenance, acquisition batches, and feature-selection procedure are unknown.

analysis.observed_result: Hypothetical reported predictive discrimination; no metric or dataset is supplied.

claims.statement: The image-feature pipeline predicts the hypothetical morphology label in new cultures.
assumptions: Held-out cultures are independent of training and preprocessing selection.
